title: Yellowed Golden Dutch Cheese Casserole
description: A garlicky, cheese-pull, nostalgic Dutch dish featuring gherkin relish, braise, and lacto-vegetarian-friendly ingredients, served in a molcajete vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic in butter until softened.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together the flour, milk, salt, and pepper, and cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the shredded Gouda cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the gherkin relish to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Transfer the cheese sauce to the skillet with the onion and garlic mixture, and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a molcajete vessel and top with additional shredded Gouda cheese.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
